title: IdP assertion timeliness & session lifecycle compatibility (Okta / Azure AD / Google Workspace / Ping)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Investigate and document IdP-specific behaviors for SAML assertion time/window semantics, session lifecycle (login/SL0/timeout/SLO), and how those interact with RBAC v2 session binding and audit logging. Produce test cases and remediation guidance for Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and Ping.
body:
Background: As we move to RBAC v2 we need a reliable way to bind SAML assertions and IdP sessions to Redwood sessions so audit logs accurately reflect who performed management actions and to allow deterministic session revocation. Multiple customers have reported mismatched session expiry, stale assertion conditions, and rare SLO (single logout) races that caused permission drift. This ticket enumerates expected behaviors per IdP, a compatibility test matrix, and recommended changes to session handling, assertion validation, and audit enrichment.

Goals:
- Define consistent server-side semantics for assertion_issued_at, not_before (nbs), and not_on_or_after across IdPs.
- Ensure RBAC v2 session objects include stable session identifiers derived from SAML where available (e.g., SessionIndex) and fallback strategies.
- Update audit payload schema to include assertion metadata (IdP, SessionIndex, assertion timestamps, AuthnContext) for postmortem.
- Provide IdP-specific remediation (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, Ping) and test cases to include in QA harness.

Why unique: Existing docs focus on attribute mapping and generic quirks. This ticket focuses narrowly on temporal semantics, lifecycle events (SLO handling, forced logout, session revocation), and audit enrichment so incident triage is fast and attribution is correct.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Confluence doc created with per-IdP timing semantics and a section mapping to RBAC v2 behaviours
A2: Test matrix with automated tests for assertion validity window and SLO flow added to sso-integration-suite (pass/fail flags per IdP)
A3: Server-side session model updated to persist IdP SessionIndex when present and clear mapping for fallback when absent
A4: Audit log schema extended and prod pipeline validated (sample events indexed in staging logging cluster)
A5: Implementation PR linked and reviewed with security sign-off
test_matrix: Okta: native SAML app with short skew (clock skew +60s) - verify NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter enforcement + SessionIndex present
Azure AD: SAML responses sometimes omit SessionIndex - verify fallback to NameID + Assertion ID hashing and impact on logout flow
Google Workspace: assertion timestamps are UTC but AuthnContext can be missing - verify acceptance policy and audit tagging
Ping: aggressive SLO (front-channel) - simulate asynchronous logout events and ensure session revocation race handling
Edge cases: signed timestamps vs unsigned, unsigned responses, delayed delivery (network variance), and multiple concurrent assertions during refresh flows
remediation_steps: 1) Normalize assertion time checks: allow configurable clock skew per IdP (default 120s) and make it configurable per-tenant
2) Persist session binding: store SessionIndex if present; else derive stable id = SHA256(NameID + AssertionID + Issuer) and surface it in RBAC v2 session record

3) SLO handling: treat front-channel SLO as advisory; attempt server-initiated RevokeSession(session_binding) and emit audit event. If Revoke fails, mark session state as "pending_logout" and backoff retries

4) Audit enrichment: include fields assertion_id, session_binding, issuer, authn_instant, not_before, not_on_or_after, authn_context_classref in every admin/audit event created from SSO-authenticated actions
5) Monitoring: add metrics for assertion rejections by reason (expired, premature, invalid_signature), SLO events processed, and unresolved pending_logout counts
comments: 2025-02-11 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket. Initial exploratory tests show Azure AD omits SessionIndex for our test app. See quick notes in confluence draft.
2025-02-14 - Marco Chen: Implemented local derivation prototype (NameID+AssertionID hash). Needs review for collision risk and privacy concerns.
2025-02-18 - Priya Rao (Security): Reviewed approach; requested that derived session_binding be HMAC'd with tenant-specific key before storage to avoid leaking NameID data in logs.
2025-02-22 - QA (Evan Morales): Added automated test scaffolding to sso-integration-suite. Tests for Okta and Ping pass; Azure AD and Google need minor assertions updates.
2025-02-28 - Marco Chen: Implementation PR opened (platform#1210) and linked. Requesting security review and staging run for audit log enrichment
audit_notes: Audit schema change: add top-level fields: idp_issuer, assertion_id, session_binding, authn_instant, not_before, not_on_or_after, authn_context_classref
Retention: assertion metadata persisted for 90 days by default (aligns with audit retention policy). For long-running sessions, only last assertion snapshot is preserved to limit storage.
Privacy: Mask NameID in audit events unless customer has explicitly enabled full identifiers; use hash prefix for searchability
Alerting: add alert when >1% of assertions are rejected due to skew for a tenant over 1 hour
follow_ups: Document tenant configuration UI for per-IdP clock skew and HMAC key rotation
Add migration runbook for existing sessions to backfill session_binding where possible
Coordinate with Solutions Eng to notify customers using deprecated SAML bindings
